sites.name: Global headquarters
sites.description: Global headquarters in New York City; Pfizer had 251 owned and leased properties worldwide (about 37 million square feet) at end-2024.

source.label: FY2024 Form 10-K, Item 2. Properties
source.quote: Our global headquarters are located in New York City. … As of December 31, 2024, we had 251 owned and leased properties worldwide, amounting to approximately 37 million square feet.

sites.name: PGS Kalamazoo
sites.description: 1,300 acre facility manufacturing active pharmaceutical ingredients (API) and drug product (DP).

source.label: Pfizer, U.S. Manufacturing Sites (pfizer.com)
source.quote: PGS Kalamazoo, MI … The 1,300 acre facility located in Kalamazoo, Michigan manufactures active pharmaceutical ingredients (API) and drug product (DP).

source.quote: PGS Sanford, NC … The 230-acre site in Sanford, North Carolina site has flexible, multi-product manufacturing capabilities and facilities.

sites.name: PGS Pearl River
sites.description: More than 100 years of innovation and manufacturing; 19 products discovered, developed and approved at the site.

source.label: Pfizer, U.S. Manufacturing Sites (pfizer.com)
source.quote: PGS Pearl River, NY … With more than 100 years of rich history in innovation and manufacturing excellence, 19 products- including various vaccines, antibiotics, and oncology medicines, have been discovered, developed, and approved at the Pearl River, New York site.

sites.name: PGS North Creek
sites.description: Produces antibody drug conjugates (ADCs) and antibody intermediates; joined the network with the Seagen acquisition.

source.label: Pfizer, U.S. Manufacturing Sites (pfizer.com)
source.quote: PGS North Creek, WA … The North Creek site, integrated into Pfizer’s network following the Seagen acquisition, produces antibody drug conjugates (ADCs) and antibody intermediates.

notes: Pfizer's 10-K gives only company-wide facility counts (251 properties; Pfizer Global Supply responsible for 37 plants, 'including in Belgium, Germany, India, Ireland, Italy, Japan, Singapore and the U.S.') and PP&E for the U.S. versus two international groups; the 10-K does not say which countries are Developed or Emerging Markets. No state or country breakdown of employees, investment or taxes was found: the 10-K gives only 'approximately 81,000 people worldwide', and the 2024 Impact Report Performance Data file has no headcount by geography. pfizer.com's U.S. Manufacturing Sites page (undated, read Nov 2026) says 11 manufacturing sites and 2 distribution centers and 'More than 10,000 U.S. colleagues dedicated to manufacturing and supply operations', with no per-site headcount; six of its sites are listed here (Franklin OH, Middleton WI, Rochester MI and Sanford North NC are left out to stay within 12 sites and favor the largest by stated size). Revenue by geography is in the records and not repeated.
